title: Use the Green Slip Price Check
summary: Use the Green Slip Price Check to compare Compulsory Third Party (CTP) Green Slip quotes from all insurers for common vehicle types.
intro: The Green Slip Price Check is a quick and easy way to get a CTP Green Slip quote comparison from all insurers, for the most common vehicle types.
what_you_need: Driver licence or registration billing number
Vehicle details, insurance, and driving history

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to get a price comparison.

external_links.text: how the Green Slip Price Check works

faqs.q: How can I get a CTP Green Slip quote comparison?
faqs.a: You can use the Green Slip Price Check to compare quotes from all insurers for common vehicle types.

faqs.q: What information do I need to use the Green Slip Price Check?
faqs.a: You can use a driver licence or registration billing number, a vehicle number plate or VIN, or vehicle details, insurance, and driving history.

faqs.q: Which method provides the most accurate price?
faqs.a: Options using a driver licence or registration billing number, or a vehicle number plate or VIN, usually provide the most accurate prices.
